operating_notes.text: Swelect Energy Systems completed 10 MW of commissioning for the AAI project as of May 2026.
USolar Assetco Four Private Limited was acquired to set up a solar power plant with an initial capacity of up to 26.6 MWp DC under a group captive scheme.
Sushma Solar Energy Private Limited was acquired to set up an initial capacity of 50 MW solar power plant under group captive scheme in Rajasthan.

timeline.summary: K.V. Nachiappan, Promoter, and persons acting in concert declared no encumbrance on their 1.20% shareholding in Swelect Energy Systems during FY2026.
A Balan, Promoter of Swelect Energy Systems Limited, declared no encumbrance on promoter group’s 3.53% shareholding during FY2025-26.
SWELECT ELECTRONICS PRIVATE LIMITED, via **A Balan (Director)**, disclosed no encumbrance on its 45-share (0.00030%) holding in SWELECT ENERGY SYSTEMS LIMITED under SEBI’s Reg. 31(4)-(5) for FY2026.
SWEES EMPLOYEES WELFARE TRUST, via Trustee V.C. RAGHUNATH, disclosed no encumbrance on its 176,400 (1.16%) shares in Swelect Energy Systems under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed Swelect Energy Systems' long-term rating at CRISIL A-/Stable, short-term rating at CRISIL A2+ for ₹345 Cr bank facilities, and CRISIL A (CE)/Stable for ₹138.5 Cr NCDs.
Swelect Energy Systems commissioned a 5 MW solar power plant in Tamil Nadu for AAI.
Swelect Energy Systems approved the transfer of 1.75 million shares in ESG Green Energy to Syrma SGS Technology Limited.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹202.42 Cr (-7.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹10.2 Cr (+15.3% YoY).
Swelect Energy Systems reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹657.12 Cr and net profit of ₹57.58 Cr.
Swelect Energy Systems approved the acquisition of 100% stake in USolar Assetco Four for up to ₹3.30 Cr on May 28, 2026.
Swelect Energy Systems approved the acquisition of 100% stake in Sushma Solar Energy Private Limited for up to ₹2.27 Cr to set up a 50 MW solar power plant in Rajasthan.
